families.overview: FPE CDP is a commercial/industrial distribution panelboard using a 'single hole bus' (per Superbreakers description) onto which pairs of N-frame bolt-on molded-case breakers are mounted with OEM bus connection ('link') kits KCDP1C through KCDP5C, one kit per breaker frame family. Each kit (per Breaker King) includes screws, brackets and a deadfront cover plate and mounts two breakers (twin). Aftermarket equivalents NEF1K, NEJ1K, NFJ1K, NJL1K are cross-referenced to the OEM kits. NN-frame switches (e.g., NN633120NA) are also described as fitting CDP panelboards.

history.value: Federal Pacific Electric (Newark NJ); Stab-Lok trademark registered c.1950-51; Reliance Electric bought FPE from UV Industries in 1979; in 1986 Reliance exited breakers: breaker business to American Circuit Breaker Corp (ACBC), non-breaker parts to Electro-Mechanical Corp, Federal name -> Challenger Electric; aftermarket plant (Newark->Linden NJ) passed Challenger -> Westinghouse -> Cutler-Hammer; closed 1995 and inventory bought by John Cifrodella forming Federal Pacific Equipment Inc.; Circuit Breaker Sales (Matthews NC) acquired Federal Pacific Equipment (2007 per Wikipedia, uncited) including equipment and technical documents.
